thread:
anna: Scheduling Ember-Skyline tenant commit for 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC (change window 02:00-04:00). Plan: canary (5%) -> slice (25%) -> full. Need approvals: safety-pin, KMS status, pin version to `release/v2.4.1-rc3`. Any blockers?

mike: FYI there's a DB snapshot job 03-21 01:30-02:15 UTC. Recommend shifting canary to 02:20 to avoid overlap. infra capacity OK for canary, full requires node warmup.

sara: KMS rotation note: we cannot rotate customer key during window. Ember rep said current key is fine. if they wanted swap it must be done pre-window.

anna: ok adjust schedule -> `rolloutctl set-schedule --tenant ember-skyline --time "2026-03-21T02:20:00Z"`

deploybot: DeployBot: scheduled canary for ember-skyline at 2026-03-21T02:20:00Z. Canary config: 5% traffic, timeout=120s, model pin `redwood/llama2-13b-quant-v3`, runtime `runt-3.1.0`. See /deploys/ember-skyline/1718201234

julian: Proposing rollback thresholds: error rate >3% for 5m OR p50 latency +100ms vs baseline => immediate rollback. Rollback steps in runbook: 1) `rolloutctl abort --tenant ember-skyline` 2) revert routing 3) open incident channel `#inc-ember-skyline`.

mike: autoscale tweak: scaleUpThreshold=60% CPU, warmup=6m. I'll ensure extra nodes provisioned by 02:00.

sara: ember cust rep signed off on no KMS rotation. +1

anna: enabling safety-pin: canary only, block automatic ramp to slice until manual ok. Pin to `release/v2.4.1-rc3`.

mike: ack

julian: ack, I'll monitor metrics. @ops-bot please standby.

ops-bot: Oncall: julian is oncall for this window. Pager rules active. Link: https://oncall.redwood/shift/2026-03-21

anna: final checklist posted: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ember-skyline-rollout (contains rollback steps, who to page, deploy links). Please drop a :thumbsup: to approve.

mike: :thumbsup:

sara: :thumbsup:

julian: :thumbsup:

anna: canary looks good. julian, hold slice ramp until 02:45 for extended observation.

julian: waiting. if stable for +20m I'll sign off for slice.
